criteria.initial_point: The first displayed score advances exactly one point from 0-0.
criteria.point_count: One inferred point for each displayed state, plus one terminal point inferred from HK.
criteria.server_and_winner: Raw HG and HK codes are present and each is 1 or 2.
criteria.terminal_point: The last displayed score gives HK a game point, so the inferred terminal winner is unambiguous.
criteria.within_game_transition: Every successive score advances one point under standard tennis scoring, including deuce/advantage returns.

limitations: 154,887 is a strict, high-confidence lower bound; invalid game rows are excluded even when some internal point transitions might still be recoverable.
A complete set or match history is not established by valid game rows; tiebreak point sequences and missing source rows need separate validation.
No inferred point rows were written to the canonical archives or substituted for the retained raw game-sequence records.
scope: Read-only audit of tennis_points records with record_kind=game_sequence.
